author: Klarna
text: 18h Big news from Klarna today - we’ve just deepened our partnership with Mollie, one of Europe’s leading payment service providers. If you've been following our acquiring partner strategy, you know why this matters - Mollie brings 350,000+ merchants across Europe into the fold, who can choose to offer Klarna through the integration they already have with Mollie. That's the point of deals like this: one integration gets you our full product suite - Pay in Full, Pay in 3, Financing - live across 26 markets. No new contracts every time we expand, no engineering lift on the merchant side. “This deepened agreement with Mollie opens up Klarna to merchants across Europe in a whole new way,” said David Sykes, President and Chief Commercial Officer at Klarna. “Mollie’s merchants across Europe will now have the same seamless access to Klarna as if they’d integrated with us directly.” Excited to keep building on all of the successful work we’ve done to date. 524 8 Comments Like Comment Share Mia Elise Hunter 18h Thanks for the great partnership and hard work to get this over the line! text: 9h Restaurant marketers, this one’s for you. Now you can win back no-shows, welcome guests before they arrive, and reward your VIPs with more help from your guest data. author: Wise
text: 17h Hundreds of hackers. Two cities. A whole weekend of sharp ideas. Last month, we had the privilege of sponsoring two incredible student hackathons: partnering with IKU Womxn in STEM in London and BME Hack Night & Day in Budapest. We challenged teams of 3–5 students with a real-world problem tied straight to one of Wise’s core pillars. Their task: build a product, fintech or beyond, that removes friction and makes everyday life run smoother. A massive thank you to the organizers for bringing everyone together, congratulations to the winning teams, and a huge shout out to the Wisers who rolled up their sleeves to mentor. Incredible momentum all around. On to the next build. 🚀 🚀 Ready to join our mission? author: aliabdaal
text:
Comment BIZZ and I’ll send you my free list of 38 business books, along with my notes and summaries 👇

If you have a full-time job but want to start a business, these are five books I’d recommend:

The 4-Hour Workweek by @timferriss: A classic for rethinking how work could fit around your life.

Million Dollar Weekend by @noahkagan: For getting out of your head and testing an idea in 48 hours.

The Millionaire Fastlane by @mj.demarco: For understanding how businesses actually work.

$100M Offers by Alex @hormozi: For turning your existing expertise into something people want to pay for.

$100M Leads by Alex Hormozi: For figuring out how to get strangers interested in buying it.

Obviously, reading won’t build the business for you. But these are a useful starting point, as long as you actually try some of the advice.
